summary: Eqraft is a Dutch maker of grading, weighing, bagging and handling machines and complete lines for potatoes and onions, based in Emmeloord. Its roots go back to Emmeloord Repair and Construction, founded in 1984. Hydratec Industries NV has been the majority shareholder since January 2025.
founded: 1984 (as Emmeloord Repair and Construction; continued as Eqraft from 2017, under Proqraft BV from 2019)
ownership: Majority shareholder Hydratec Industries NV since January 2025
machines: Combination Scale: multihead weigher with 12 or 16 buckets of 14 litres, used for seed potatoes
Baxmatic: automatic bag filler for 1.5-25 kg bags
Cratefiller: crate filling, shown with the weigher at Interpom 2026
Eqrader potato version: optical sorter by size, weight, shape and defects (in development)
Brushing Machine: brushing and cleaning of produce
Storage Bunker: buffer storage in the line
Bin Tipper: tipping bins into the line
Bin Filler: filling bins with produce
Big Bag Filler Bulk: filling big bags with bulk produce
facts: 2017: ERC merged with Qreenno and Propak and continued as Eqraft
Klaas van de Poppe became CEO effective 1 May 2026
Potato Eqrader capacity target: 15-20 tonnes per hour for table potatoes
Potato Eqrader capacity target: 25-30 tonnes per hour for the fries industry
Schuiling seed potato packing line target: 15-20 tonnes per hour

contact.address: Eqraft (Proqraft BV), Werktuigenweg 7, 8304 AZ Emmeloord, Netherlands

limitations: Staff numbers, revenue and capacities for most machines are not published on the pages read.
The machinery page does not say which machines are used for potatoes, and the potato version of the Eqrader was described as in development with no commercial installation named.
